[[Lok The Mischievous]] is found in a large dining hall on the first level of [[Arachni's Haunt]].  As you approach him, rolling balls of fire emerge from the huge fireplace immediately behind him toward you.  When your melee characters are battling him, they will receive the [[Burning]] [[condition]] from said fireplace.

== Locations ==
* [[Depths of Tyria]]
** {{NPC location|Arachni's Haunt}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Fire Attunement}}
* {{skill icon|Fire Storm}}
* {{skill icon|Flare}}
* {{skill icon|Glyph of Lesser Energy}}
* {{skill icon|Rodgort's Invocation}}
* {{skill icon|Savannah Heat}} ([[Elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Lok's Scepter]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Unlike most Fire [[Elemental]]s, this [[boss]] does not have immunity to burning.
* Lok is an extremely dangerous boss in [[Hard Mode]].  His spells hit for hundreds of points of damage, and he uses multiple [[area of effect]] spells.  Make sure to bring some good protection spells like [[Protective Spirit]], or protection from fire damage in the form of [[Ward Against Harm]]. Or consider going offence with [[Pain Inverter]], he will get massive damage if you have enough minions walking around.

== Trivia ==
* Named after [[w:Loki|Loki]], a Norse mythological [[w:Jötunn|Jötunn]] who lived among the [[w:Æsir|Æsir]] gods and was connected with mischief, fire, and magic.
